newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Youths smash windows in Geneva anti-police demo.
newsitem.headline: Youths smash windows in Geneva anti-police demo.

text.p: Some 150 youths protesting against alleged police violence smashed shop windows and damaged cars as they marched through central Geneva on Saturday.

The youths, who told reporters they were part of a Europe-wide movement, also looted goods from a supermarket and stopped trolleybuses by pulling their electric cables off overhead wires, eyewitnesses said.
Police said several of the demonstrators were detained, but the protest broke up after an hour. Such violence is rare in the Swiss international city.
